name: pressure-plate
comment: A wooden pressure plate (72, EnumMobType.everything) at (0, 61, 0) with wire at x = 1, 2 and a stone plate (70, mobs) at (4, 61, 0). An item (cobblestone) is spawned above each at t = 0 and its motion zeroed, so it falls straight onto the plate: Entity.moveEntity calls BlockPressurePlate.onEntityCollidedWithBlock with the item running its update (the plate's getEntitiesWithinAABBExcludingEntity must see it); the wooden plate presses and rechecks every 20 ticks from updateTick (entity not in hand); the stone plate ignores the item (not an EntityLiving). At t = 40 the first item is moved off the plate (set_pos), so the next check releases it; at t = 70 a third item falls onto it again. Dumps: plates, power under them and on the wire, the items, the scheduled ticks. ray_trace down onto the wooden plate every 5 ticks: BlockPressurePlate.setBlockBoundsBasedOnState (1/32 high pressed, 1/16 released).
